understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level, completing the current BP35 level and continuing until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is performed with directional actions and consumes one turn. Gravity was DOWN, causing the player to fall when possible; horizontal movement could also result in landing on a lower tile. Clicking a clickable tile removes it, though clicking an unavailable or non-impactful tile leaves the player in place while still consuming a turn. Spike tiles are hazards that end the current attempt, with two attempts and 50 turns available per level. Undo was not observed in the recent actions.
